feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: ICE shooting in NYC fuels tension between New York officials and Trump administration
entry.summary: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement shot a man in New York City. It raised tensions between the Trump administration and New York officials over the state's sanctuary policies.

entry.title: The U.S. last held a public execution in the 1930s. The Pentagon wants to change that
entry.summary: The Pentagon says it will livestream the firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan at Fort Hood, the site of his 2009 mass shooting. That would be the first public execution in the U.S. since the 1930s.

entry.title: U.S. working to reverse an Egyptian man's third-country deportation to Africa
entry.summary: The Trump administration's effort to return Ahmed Soliman to the U.S. come after an Arizona judge said his deportation violated due process.

entry.title: Fill in the blank in the quiz: A plague research employee in Russia died from ____
entry.summary: Plus: Nobels! Protests! Ambiguous quotes! A mysterious death in Russia!

entry.title: In Central African Republic, deported immigrants find themselves in limbo
entry.summary: The Trump administration says it has deported more than 25,000 people to countries to which they have no ties. NPR spoke to three men who say it feels like they've lost control over their own lives.

entry.title: Why we remember: One student's journey into memory
entry.summary: Why one teen can't let go of the time he ate fries with his great-grandpa.

entry.title: A student hated reading for years. Her podcast explores finding the right diagnosis
entry.summary: Middle schooler Cora Walsh of Long Island, N.Y., has won the 2026 NPR Student Podcast Challenge with a story about her journey with dyslexia.

entry.title: Long-deployed USS Lincoln servicemembers reunited with families
entry.summary: On Thursday in San Diego, servicemembers who have been on an extended deployment on the USS Abraham Lincoln were reunited with family members.

entry.title: Christa Pike is walking with help and eating after failed execution attempt
entry.summary: Pike has begun walking and eating again at a hospital a week after surviving Tennessee's attempt to execute her with lethal drugs, her attorneys said Thursday.

entry.title: Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed
entry.summary: The Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the execution would be "public.
